questionnaire.prompt: Name the source contract and SHA-256.
Name horizontal and vertical carrier nodes.
Report theta, radius, direction and winding.
Are the Crystal vector, RE Exit and DO-prime Return identical?
Name the exact Return target and anchor.
Does the record mutate the source?
Name one prohibited inference from the claim boundary.
questionnaire.gold_rule: Any one of universal schema, capability, shared mechanism, GLB mutation, Study, Finding or publication.

counterbalance: Odd participant IDs receive A then B; even participant IDs receive B then A.
stop_rule: No claim from fewer than 8 completed participants; stop superiority language on tie, worse UDF result, unblinding, unequal instructions or missing timing.
claim_boundary: Protocol preparation is not an independent Human test, utility result or scientific activation.
